story.title: The dodo bird had a secret sensory world scientists are only now discovering
story.reason: Overturns old misconceptions about the dodo, revealing a clever and sensory-rich creature that charms the imagination.
story.title_ja: ドードー鳥の知られざる感覚の世界：旧来のイメージを覆す発見
story.reason_ja: おっとりしたイメージだったドードー鳥が、実は豊かな感覚を持つ賢い鳥だったことが分かり、昔の誤解を解く微笑ましいニュースです。
story.jp_copy: これまでのイメージとは異なり、絶滅したドードー鳥が実は豊かな感覚世界と知性を持っていたことが最新の研究で判明しました。長年の誤解が解け、ドードー鳥の賢く魅力的な素顔が明らかになる、知的好奇心に満ちた嬉しい発見です。
story.en_copy: Long misunderstood, the dodo bird is now being revealed as a clever creature with a rich sensory world. Scientists are overturning old misconceptions, giving us a fresh and charming perspective on a smart bird whose true nature is finally being appreciated.
story.duck_jp: ドードー鳥は実はとっても賢かったんですね！誤解が解けて良かった！
story.duck_en: The dodo was clever all along! Glad history is setting the record straight.
story.x_jp: 鈍感だと思われていたドードー鳥の秘密が解明！実は豊かな感覚と知性を持った賢い鳥だったことが分かりました。
story.x_en: New discoveries show the dodo bird was actually clever and sensory-rich, overturning old misconceptions!

concepts.title_ja: 科学者の研究室：ドードーの脳と感覚の解明
concepts.title_en: The Scientist's Lab: Unlocking the Dodo's Brain
concepts.concept_ja: 研究者のアヒルが、鮮やかなホログラムを用いてドードー鳥の優れた脳構造と豊かな感覚世界を発見する場面です。
concepts.concept_en: A scientist duck examining a glowing hologram of the dodo bird's brain and sensory system in a bright, modern laboratory.
concepts.composition_ja: 明るく清潔な研究所。小さな丸メガネと白衣を身につけた黄色いアヒルがデスクの前に立ち、立体的なホログラムのドードー鳥と光る脳のネットワークを見つめています。
concepts.composition_en: A bright, modern lab setting. A friendly yellow duck in tiny round glasses and a miniature lab coat stands at a desk, peering curiously at a 3D glowing hologram of a dodo bird highlighting its brain and scent sensory paths.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Editorial 3D illustration for news art. The Daily Duck mascot, a cute friendly bright yellow duck with an orange beak, large glossy dark eyes, a tiny feather tuft on its head, and a warm expression, wearing small round glasses and a tiny white lab coat. The duck stands at a sleek modern desk inside a bright clean science laboratory, looking with wide curious eyes at a soft blue glowing 3D hologram of a dodo bird. Inside the dodo hologram, gentle sparkling lights trace its brain structure and sensory pathways. Clean lighting, soft depth of field, vibrant colors, vector-like 3D render style, minimalist editorial composition suitable for a website hero image. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
concepts.alt_ja: 研究室でメガネをかけた黄色いアヒルが、ドードー鳥の脳と感覚を示す光るホログラムを興味深く観察しているイラスト。
concepts.alt_en: Illustration of a yellow duck mascot in a lab coat observing a glowing hologram showing the brain structure and senses of a dodo bird.

concepts.title_ja: 美術館のギャラリー：過去の誤解を覆すドードーの素顔
concepts.title_en: Museum Gallery: Unveiling the Dodo's True Face
concepts.concept_ja: 学芸員のアヒルが、鈍感だと思われていた昔のドードーのスケッチをめくり、知性あふれる生き生きとした新しい姿をお披露目するストーリーです。
concepts.concept_en: A museum curator duck proudly unveiling a vibrant glowing portrait of a smart dodo bird, pushing aside an old monochrome drawing.
concepts.composition_ja: 洗練されたモダンなギャラリー空間。小さな蝶ネクタイを着けた黄色いアヒルが中央に立ち、古ぼけたドードーの素描を取り払い、奥から現れた知的で鮮やかなドードーのポートレートを誇らしげに指し示しています。
concepts.composition_en: A sleek modern art museum layout. A cute yellow duck wearing a tiny red bow tie stands between two panels, peeling back a dusty old monochrome portrait of a dodo to reveal a bright, glowing, colorful picture of a sharp-eyed, intelligent dodo surrounded by subtle sensory ripples.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Editorial 3D stylized illustration. The Daily Duck mascot, a charming bright yellow duck with an orange beak, glossy dark eyes, a small feather tuft on top, and a cheerful smile, wearing a tiny dark red bow tie. The duck stands in a minimalist museum gallery, proudly gesturing toward a split presentation board. On the left side, a curtain pulls back from a dull grayscale sketch of a dodo. On the right side, a vibrant illuminated canvas reveals a smart, sharp-eyed dodo bird floating amid colorful sensory wave rings and golden light sparkles. Warm gallery spotlighting, clean lines, high-end editorial feel, rich visual contrast. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
concepts.alt_ja: ギャラリーでアヒルが古いドードー鳥の絵をめくり、知性あふれるドードー鳥の新しい肖像画を披露しているイラスト。
concepts.alt_en: Illustration of a yellow duck mascot unveiling a bright, intelligent portrait of a dodo bird in a museum, replacing an old dull drawing.

concepts.title_ja: 楽園の森の探検：豊かな嗅覚と感覚の発見
concepts.title_en: Island Jungle Explorer: A World of Rich Senses
concepts.concept_ja: 探検家アヒルがドードー鳥と一緒に熱帯の豊かな森を歩き、ドードーが持つ鋭い嗅覚と豊かな感覚世界を体験する自然描写です。
concepts.concept_en: An explorer duck walking beside a friendly dodo bird through a sunlit tropical forest, following glowing trails of scents and sounds.
concepts.composition_ja: 陽の光が差し込む美しい森。探検帽をかぶった黄色いアヒルが虫眼鏡を手に、可愛らしいドードー鳥と並んで歩いています。空気中にはドードーの優れた感覚を象徴する光る香りの帯やキラキラした星が漂っています。
concepts.composition_en: A vibrant sunlit tropical forest. A friendly yellow duck wearing a miniature brown pith helmet holds a gold magnifying glass, walking cheerfully next to a friendly, stylized dodo bird. Glowing scent swirls and floating sparkles wind through exotic flowers around them.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Charming modern editorial illustration. The Daily Duck mascot, a cute bright yellow duck with an orange beak, glossy dark eyes, a feather tuft on its head, wearing a small beige safari explorer hat. The duck is walking through a sun-dappled tropical forest beside a stylized, friendly dodo bird with soft brown feathers and an expressive curved beak. Golden sunbeams filter through green foliage, while luminous pastel scent trails and sparkling star dust drift around fragrant tropical flowers, visually representing the dodo's heightened sensory awareness. Bright, joyful atmosphere, soft focus background, visually compelling 3D digital art. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
concepts.alt_ja: 陽の光が注ぐ熱帯の森で、探検帽をかぶったアヒルとドードー鳥が光る香りの軌跡に囲まれながら歩いているイラスト。
concepts.alt_en: Illustration of a duck mascot in an explorer hat walking alongside a dodo bird through a tropical forest surrounded by glowing scent trails.

concepts.title_ja: インフォグラフィック教室：ドードーの隠された知能
concepts.title_en: Infographic Classroom: The Dodo's Hidden Smarts
concepts.concept_ja: 講師のアヒルがポインターを持ち、ポップなグラフィックボードでドードーの知性と感覚の仕組みを分かりやすく解説するプレゼン風デザインです。
concepts.concept_en: An educator duck giving a cheerful presentation in front of a clean infographic board highlighting the dodo's sensory capabilities.
concepts.composition_ja: パステル調の明るいスタジオ。指示棒を持った黄色いアヒルが大きな展示用ボードの横に立ち、ひらめきアイコンや感覚アイコンで表現されたドードーの能力を生き生きと説明しています。
concepts.composition_en: A clean pastel studio setup. A cheerful yellow duck holding a small wooden pointer stands next to a large graphic display board filled with cute visual symbols—lightbulbs, glowing nose sparkles, and brain icons—explaining the dodo's smart nature.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Clean 3D vector-style editorial artwork. The Daily Duck mascot, an adorable yellow duck with a friendly expression, smooth orange beak, glossy dark eyes, and a neat feather tuft on its head, holding a wooden pointer baton. The duck stands in front of a modern minimalist presentation board showing friendly stylized visual icons: a golden lightbulb above a dodo silhouette, soft glowing scent swirls, and subtle brain sparkle symbols. Soft pastel backdrop in sky blue and cream, gentle drop shadows, isometric perspective, bright and engaging editorial design. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
concepts.alt_ja: 指示棒を持った黄色いアヒルが、ドードー鳥の知能や感覚を表すグラフィックボードの前でプレゼンをしているイラスト。
concepts.alt_en: Illustration of a yellow duck mascot holding a pointer next to a visual diagram showing the intelligence and senses of the dodo bird.

concepts.title_ja: 秘密の飛び出す絵本：歴史の図書室での発見
concepts.title_en: The Secret Pop-Up Book: Rediscovering History
concepts.concept_ja: 図書室でアヒルが大きな飛び出す絵本を開くと、立体的なドードーと豊かな感覚の世界が目の前に飛び出してくる幻想的な一瞬です。
concepts.concept_en: A cozy library setting where a scholar duck opens a giant magic pop-up book, bringing the dodo's sensory world to 3D life.
concepts.composition_ja: 温かみのある木製デスク。小さな丸眼鏡をかけた黄色いアヒルが大きな本を開くと、ページから島と可愛いドードー鳥、そして輝く感覚の輪が立体的に飛び出し、アヒルの顔を優しく照らしています。
concepts.composition_en: A high-angle overhead view of a warm, quiet archive library desk. A sweet yellow duck wearing small spectacles gazes down at a large open pop-up storybook. From the paper pages, a vibrant 3D mini tropical landscape pops up with a lively dodo bird emitting soft warm light rings.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Warm, whimsical editorial picture book style render. High-angle perspective looking down at a wooden study desk in a soft-lit library. The Daily Duck mascot, a bright yellow duck with an orange beak, dark glossy eyes, and a cute feather tuft, wearing tiny reading glasses, leans over a giant vintage book. As the duck opens the book, a colorful pop-up paper craft scene unfolds, showing a cute dodo bird standing on green grass with glittering sensory ring lights floating around it. Cozy warm lighting, soft shadows, enchanting narrative mood, 3D digital illustration. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
concepts.alt_ja: 図書室でメガネをかけたアヒルが飛び出す絵本を開き、光るドードー鳥の世界が飛び出して感動しているイラスト。
concepts.alt_en: Illustration of a yellow duck mascot opening a magic pop-up book that brings a glowing dodo bird and its sensory world to life.
